page.overview:
Who is Clay Soldier?

These forgotten and lifeless statues of royal soldiers, which seem to be intricate and interesting archaeological finds, are actually of Outworld design and origin. They were enchanted and brought to life by sorcery. Once they are animated, the Clay Soldiers are simply controlled by any outside force, or even a person with knowledge in or gifted with magic. They will attack anyone and anything that stands in their path.

The Clay Soldiers are loosely and greatly modeled after the Dragon King's Army, built to honor the memory of the fallen empire of Outworld's first sovereign ruler.
